CED Coverage Matrix

Every required topic family of the AP Computer Science Principles Course and Exam Description (Fall 2023 CED, current), mapped to when we teach it and with what. 10 of 10 topic families covered. The Unity build (Units 1-8) carries Algorithms & Programming and the program-development half of Creative Development; Unit 9 exists because a year in Unity alone cannot teach you binary, networks, or impact — and the exam asks about all three.

Weighting Check

Where the AP score comes from: the end-of-course exam (70%) — 70 multiple-choice questions in 120 minutes plus two written-response questions in 60 minutes, all in Bluebook — and the Create performance task (30%), due April 30. The MC section weights the five big ideas like this, and here is how our calendar spends its days:

Big ideaExam weight (MC)Where we teach itB-days
1: Creative Development10-13%All year ( jams, Create PT) + 9.10awoven
2: Data17-22%Unit 9 (9.1a-9.6a)6
3: Algorithms & Programming30-35%Units 1-8 + card jam (10.2a-d)41
4: Computer Systems & Networks11-15%Unit 9 (9.7a-9.9a)3
5: Impact of Computing21-26%Unit 9 (9.6a, 9.10a) + jam retros2 + woven

Algorithms & Programming is the heaviest exam weight and it gets the most calendar by design: every single class of first semester is a lab that programs something real. Data and Systems get a dedicated, concentrated January-February unit so they are fresh (but not too fresh) in May, and the exam sprint re-touches everything in weight order.
